messages:
Maya R: quick thread — we need an updated battlecard for the 'Serving-first' webinar next Wed. focus: three concise competitive levers vs cloud AI platforms, LLM APIs, and infra vendors. aim for field-ready snippets + one-pager.
Conor H: got it. sales wants deployable lines for cold outreach and a 2-paragraph AE playbook. can we avoid heavy numbers unless lab appendix available?
Leah D: draft hooks below, keeping claims cautious (use 'up to' or ranges). open to edits.
Leah D: 
- Cloud platforms: "Predictable production latency — engineered routing and reserved pools, not shared best-effort queues."
  • Backup: automatic failover to reserved capacity and P95 SLOs in docs.
- LLM APIs: "Keep your API contract; cut unit cost with automated batching & response-prefix caching."
  • Backup: workload-aware batching and cache hits that lower token spend.
- Infra vendors: "We deliver inference as a product — unified runtime + rollout/observability out of the box."
  • Backup: built-in canary/A-B rollouts, per-route tracing, and traceable regressions.
Sam T: marketing ask — produce three length variations for each snippet: short (single line), email (2-3 lines), and slide bullet. Leah, can you run those?
Leah D: yes. ETA 2pm PT. will avoid jargon in short lines (use 'response-prefix caching' only in appendix).
Ravi N: bench note — ops will provide lab harness and raw numbers. please prefix any numeric claim with 'up to' and link appendix.
Maya R: good. also need an objection FAQ for procurement: SLAs, private deployment, key management. Sam, can you draft 4 Q/A bullets?
Sam T: adding: 
- Q: "Do you offer private VPC/on-prem?" A: "Yes — private control plane and optional on-prem package; KMS integrations supported."
- Q: "How are SLAs enforced?" A: "Dedicated capacity plans with SLA-backed uptime and latency tiers."
- Q: "Can you guarantee consistent costs?" A: "We provide predictive pricing with reserved capacity and tooling to reduce per-token spend."
- Q: "How do we rollback bad model updates?" A: "Canary rollouts and automatic fallback to pinned versions."
doc-bot: Shared doc created: https://docs.google.com/document/d/EXAMPLE (marketing/battlecards/serving-webinar)
Conor H: let's pick 4 one-liners for SDR play — prioritize econ and latency. propose: 1) "Lower predictable unit cost through workload-aware batching & caching." 2) "Consistent tail latency via engineered routing and reserved capacity." 3) "Rollouts & tracing for production-grade deployments." 4) "Same API surface; deploy where you need it (hosted, reserved, private)."
Leah D: reword 4: "Same API — choose hosted, reserved, or VPC deployment."
Maya R: final checklist: 
- Leah: produce 3 length variants for each hook (due 2pm PT)
- Ravi: upload bench appendix and harness link by 5pm
- Sam: draft procurement FAQ and 4 SDR lines by EOD
- Conor: run quick field test with 2 SDRs tomorrow morning
Leah D: starting edits now. will post to the shared doc when ready.
Maya R: thanks — I'll collate and publish the battlecard once pieces are in. :sparkles:
